rationale: Merge Prospect Storage into GlidePath Power Solutions. Quinbrook identifies GlidePath as the manager-level portfolio company and Prospect as its operating project. Direct company evidence describes Prospect as a greenfield GlidePath development, while court and ERCOT records identify West Columbia Storage LLC as a wholly owned GlidePath subsidiary and the project as an operating 9.9 MW resource with a December 12, 2019 in-service date. Powin, Habitat, ERCOT and financing parties are not treated as owners. The project and SPV names and operating history are preserved on GlidePath.

beforeImage.name: GlidePath Power Solutions
beforeImage.subsector: Battery energy storage development and operation
beforeImage.description: GlidePath Power Solutions develops, owns and operates battery-energy-storage projects across U.S. power markets. Quinbrook acquired the platform in 2017 through its low-carbon power strategy and continues to list GlidePath as a portfolio company. The platform's operating projects include Byrd Ranch, a 50 MW/50 MWh ERCOT battery facility in Sweeny, Texas held through Byrd Ranch Storage LLC, and Meyersdale, an 18 MW/12 MWh PJM battery facility in Somerset County, Pennsylvania held through Meyersdale Storage, LLC. Byrd Ranch entered the portfolio in 2019 and began operating in November 2022; Meyersdale entered service in 2015, was acquired by GlidePath on March 19, 2019 and was repowered in late 2024. These project/SPV identities are not separate manager-level portfolio companies. No later GlidePath sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.

GlidePath acquired a wind power portfolio under Quinbrook ownership.
GlidePath acquired a 223 MW operational wind portfolio from NextEra.
GlidePath completed financing and began construction of the 50 MW/50 MWh Byrd Ranch storage project in Texas.
GlidePath appointed a new chief commercial officer.
The 18 MW/12 MWh Meyersdale battery entered service in PJM.
GlidePath Storage Operations completed the acquisition of Meyersdale Storage from the NextEra/FPL group.
GlidePath completed the repowering of the Meyersdale battery project.

afterImage.name: GlidePath Power Solutions
afterImage.subsector: Battery energy storage development and operation
afterImage.description: GlidePath Power Solutions develops, owns and operates battery-energy-storage projects across U.S. power markets. Quinbrook acquired the platform in 2017 through the Quinbrook Low Carbon Power Fund and continues to list GlidePath as a portfolio company. Its operating projects include Byrd Ranch, a 50 MW/50 MWh Texas battery facility; Meyersdale, an 18 MW/12 MWh Pennsylvania facility; and Prospect Storage, a 9.9 MW/9.9 MWh West Columbia, Texas project developed by GlidePath from greenfield construction in June 2019 and placed in service on December 12, 2019 through West Columbia Storage LLC. These project and SPV identities are not separate manager-level portfolio companies. No later GlidePath sale or signed pending ownership transaction was identified through September 1, 2026.
